title: CrystalREPA: Transferring Physical Priors from Universal MLIPs to Crystal Generative Models
abstract: arXiv:2605.08960v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Crystal generative models mainly learn what stable crystals look like, with little explicit supervision for what makes them stable. We reveal a substantial representation gap between state-of-the-art crystal generative models and pretrained universal machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) via energy probing, and show this gap can be closed by a simple training-time alignment. We propose Crystal REPresentation Alignment (CrystalREPA), a plug-and-play framework that aligns the atom-wise hidden states of generative encoders with frozen MLIP representations through an element-aware contrastive objective, transferring stability-aware atomistic priors with marginal training overhead and no additional inference cost. Across three generative frameworks, ten MLIP teachers, and two benchmark datasets, CrystalREPA consistently improves the thermodynamic stability, structural validity, and structural fidelity of generated crystals

translated_title: CrystalREPA：将物理先验从通用机器学习原子间势迁移至晶体生成模型
translated_abstract: 晶体生成模型主要学习稳定晶体的外观形态，却很少对使其稳定的因素进行显式监督。我们通过能量探测揭示了最先进的晶体生成模型与预训练的通用机器学习原子间势（MLIP）之间存在显著的表示鸿沟，并证明这一鸿沟可以通过简单的训练时对齐来弥合。我们提出了晶体表示对齐方法CrystalREPA，这是一个即插即用的框架，通过元素感知的对比目标，将生成编码器的逐原子隐藏状态与冻结的MLIP表示对齐，从而以极小的训练开销且无额外推理成本的方式迁移稳定性感知的原子级先验。在三种生成框架、十个MLIP教师模型和两个基准数据集上的实验表明，CrystalREPA持续提升了生成晶体的热力学稳定性、结构有效性和结构保真度。
tldr: CrystalREPA是一个即插即用的表示对齐框架，通过元素感知对比目标将通用机器学习原子间势中的稳定性物理先验迁移到晶体生成模型，在无额外推理成本的前提下显著提升生成晶体的热力学稳定性、结构有效性和保真度。
en_tdlr: CrystalREPA is a plug-and-play representation alignment framework that transfers stability-aware physical priors from universal MLIPs to crystal generative models via an element-aware contrastive objective, consistently improving thermodynamic stability, structural validity, and fidelity with no additional inference cost.
